div.p: This is the URL for the namespace used in nng, my site generator.
This namespace is only used for tags that occur within the content, not in the template. These are snippet and refer.

nng:snippet.name: nng-usage
nng:snippet.p: nng allows recording “snippets”, which are blocks of HTML, and then “referring” to them, which both copies the inner text of the snippet and provides a link to its source.

pre.code:
This is an example snippet!

<\nng:snippet> <\>

nng:snippet.p: Transforms into something like the following HTML:
